## Inventive to our core. Reliable by design.

At Black & Veatch, we see the world not just as it is, but as it could be. Coal plants reborn as
renewable energy hubs. Coastlines transformed to take on flood threats. Safe power and clean water
sourced closer to home. Local workforces building a low-carbon future. Infrastructure that protects
the planet and empowers all people. That's bolder vision. That's Black & Veatch.

[Learn more][16]
[bolder vision cover ]

Complex infrastructure across the planet relies on Black & Veatch's ingenuity. Together, let's
create a bolder vision for resilience and growth.

## Solving today’s infrastructure challenges

Black & Veatch’s trusted and sustainable power, water, process, and advisory solutions address our
clients’ needs, no matter their industry.

## About Fluor

Through our people, projects and partnerships, Fluor connects businesses and communities to advance
economies and employment. We create choice and opportunity on a local and global scale.

Building a better world is our purpose. We care deeply about safety and seek to drive quality and
efficiency in all that we do. We behave **ethically**, inclusively and responsibly for a brighter
future.

We support our clients in solving critical challenges. We operate throughout the project lifecycle,
from conceptual design, engineering, procurement and construction to the operations and maintenance
of facilities.

Clients, partners and communities trust Fluor because we are here for the long term – delivering
successful projects of both scale and significance for more than a century. From the spark of an
idea to a project's completion, our nearly 27,000 colleagues in more than 60 locations around the
globe provide professional and technical solutions with world-class expertise.

## Light and life
## to over a billion people

BHEL contributes more than 50% of the total power generated from conventional sources

As India’s foremost power equipment manufacturer, BHEL continues to play a pivotal role in
bolstering India’s energy security

## Harnessing the
## Power of Water

With dedicated design, engineering, erection & commissioning teams, BHEL is a one-stop solution for
Hydro Power Equipment

## Powering India
## Since 1964

With 200+ GW power generating capacity installed across the world, BHEL is the undisputed leader
amongst India's Power Plant manufacturers

## BHEL - Contributing to the
## Nation's self-reliance in the
## Aerospace sector

Chandrayaan 3 is equipped with BHEL manufactured Batteries for Lander Module & Propulsion Module &
Titanium Propellent Tank

## Fueling the Aspirations
## of Emerging India

Indigenously developed & supplied sucker rod pumps for oil & gas exploration

## Serving our sentinels
## for nearly four decades

BHEL is the sole indigenous supplier of compact heat exchangers for fighter aircrafts

## BHEL - a committed Corporate
## Citizen investing in ESG

300,000+ saplings planted in last five years

Miyawaki forests in three BHEL units with cumulative coverage of 15,500+ sq.m.

## Ensuring reliable Power
## Transmission across the nation
## with state-of-the-art equipment

The first & only Transformer Manufacturer in India having successfully short circuit tested Auto
Transformers up to 500 MVA, 400 kV Class and Generator Transformer up to 333 MVA, 765 kV Class

## Nuclear Energy - Powering a
## Sustainable & Clean Future

Only company associated with all three stages of Indian Nuclear Power Programme

## Technology Innovations
## for Sustainable Development

We invest around 2.5% of our turnover in Research & Development works

## Harnessing
## Nature's Power

We are actively working on renewable energy, energy efficient systems and low emission technologies

## Equipping
## Indian Defence &
## Paramilitary Forces

Regular supplier of Super Rapid Gun Mount Naval Guns for providing Anti-Shipping and Anti-Air
capability in addition to Naval Gun Fire Support for Land Based Operations

engaged in design, engineering, construction, testing, commissioning and servicing of a wide range
of products and services with over 180 product offerings to meet the ever-growing needs of the core
sectors of economy.

Trust that your marine propulsion, power generation and energy storage systems are secure 24/7/365.
[Our solutions][69]
[Learn more about us][70]
Whether you work as a CTO, COO or similar position

## Do not leave your uptime and reliability to chance

As a professional in the commercial marine, power generation or industrial segments, you know how
crucial uptime and reliability are for your business. Having reliable equipment and resources help
alleviate the concerns you can have, ensuring your confidence in secure operations and a business
that runs smoothly.

What We Offer You

## From design to maintenance, we've got you covered

As a systems integrator and provider of services, we take care of the complete delivery from design,
production and commissioning to support and service.

Throughout the creation process and the entire lifecycle, you can count on us to take responsibility
for your system. Your technical needs and requirements are the starting point for the solution we
create. Our goal is to ensure your system runs smoothly and delivers maximum value over time.

Project Excellence

## Your Project, Our Expertise

A professional approach to project management, combined with expertise and a trusted supplier,
ensuring control and predictability for successful delivery.

The "BOS Power Project Excellence" initiative drives continuous improvement and builds
professionalism, so that we are better equipped to serve you.

[ [PROJECT EXCELLENCE_Page_1] ][75]

**Key elements of Project Excellence:**
* **Competence:** Your projects are managed by highly skilled professionals from our Project
  Academy, with the skills and competencies required to ensure reliable and high-quality deliveries.
* **Project Model:** Ensures control and predictability from start to finish, providing consistency
  in management and delivering your projects on time and within budget.
* **Governance Framework:** Enhances project control, transparency, and accountability. Ensures
  efficient risk management and streamlined decision-making, giving you the confidence that your
  project will be executed effectively and successfully.
* ** Project Management:** Centralizes project management functions and standardizes practices,
  enhancing quality and consistency to meet the highest standards.
* **System Integrator and Provider of Services:** Gain access to expertise covering the entire
  process from design, production, and commissioning to support and service, guaranteeing a
  successful project.

Our Solutions

## Our knowledge is your security

Secure your operations 24/7 with high quality solutions based on proven technology, the right
expertise and best practices.

What Can You Expect?

## Leading you securely through the entire process

1
Tell us what you need

When you first contact us, we will listen to your requirements and identify areas that need
clarification.

2
Proposal

Once we have a clear understanding of your goals, you will be presented with a comprehensive offer
for a tailored soultion that meets your needs.

3
Design & Production

After you accept the offer, we will move forward with the project by creating a detailed design for
your solution and start production to prepare for installation.

4
Installation & Commissioning

The functionality of all systems and equipment will be tested..We will also provide comprehensive
training to your technical staff and deliver all agreed documentation.

5
Service Agreements

After implementation, choose from standard or customized service agreements with 24/7 support from
our experienced technicians in case of system failure or breakdown.

6
Optimisation

As a measure of proactive improvementWe can fine-tune your system for peak performance, assessing
upgrades to improve efficiency and functionality and presenting suggestions.

### Parts & Accessories

Keep your lawn mower and outdoor power equipment running at peak performance with Briggs & Stratton
parts and accessories. Whether you're searching for a replacement carburetor, or a simple spark
plug, Briggs & Stratton small engine parts are guaranteed to fit and built to last longer than
aftermarket or generic parts.

[Find the Right Parts][116]
[Briggs & Stratton engine oil bottle. ]

### Do-It-Yourself Maintenance

Searching for maintenance tips to perform simple service on your outdoor power equipment? View our
Maintenance How-To's to get step-by-step instructions on how to change your lawn mower engine oil or
spark plugs, replace an air filter or repair your carburetor.

[Read Maintenance How-To's][117]

## About Briggs & Stratton

With over 110 years of experience, Briggs & Stratton is trusted by millions of people around the
globe and backed by the largest service network in the industry. We are the world's largest small
engine producer and a leading manufacturer of power generation, electrification solutions, lawn and
garden turf care, and job site products.

## Cooler Master ESG

In response to the Paris Agreement, Cooler Master has established group-level greenhouse gas (GHG)
reduction targets, decarbonization pathways, and transition strategies. Our science-based targets
were officially validated by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi). Through continuous
decarbonization efforts, we have achieved meaningful progress: in 2024, our absolute GHG emissions
were approximately 59% lower than the 2022 base year, demonstrating steady advancement along our
science-based reduction pathway.

reduction targets, decarbonization pathways, and transition strategies. Our science-based targets

science-based reduction pathway.

keeping you ready for whatever comes next.

We’ve enlisted the best engineers and scientists to build power solutions ready to support you no
matter where you are on the journey to cleaner power.

[

power and high economic value.

for your job site or home.

keeping you ready for whatever comes next.

We’ve enlisted the best engineers and scientists to build power solutions ready to support you no
matter where you are on the journey to cleaner power.

[

power and high economic value.

for your job site or home.

### Forever ready. Forever steady. Forever rising. Meet the 2027 X15™.

### The Missing Link in the

Entity 4 Recycling Supertech Pvt. Ltd is building advanced solar panel recycling, PV module waste
management, and material recovery systems for India’s growing renewable energy ecosystem.

### Solar Waste Is the Next Big Challenge - and It’s Already here.

[Frame 1707495221.png]

## 2.0M+

Millions of panels

Installed across India over two decades, now approaching end-of-life decommissioning

[Frame 1707495222.png]

## <10%

Recycled

Less than 10% of end-of-life solar panels are recycled today, creating a massive circularity gap.

[Frame 1707495223.png]

## Toxic

New waste crisis

Without industrial recycling, clean energy creates hazardous landfill waste containing lead, cadmium
and other heavy metals.

[Frame 1707495411.png]

### 2.0M+

Millions of panels

Installed over 2 decades, now rapidly approaching terminal decommissioning phases.

[Frame 1707495411 (1).png]

### <10%

Under-recycled

Less than 10% of end-of-life solar panels are recycled today, creating a massive circularity gap.

[Frame 1707495412.png]

### Toxic

New waste crisis

Without industrial recycling infrastructure, clean energy creates hazardous landfill burdens.

#### Solar Waste Is the next big challenge - and It’s Already here.

#### We extract up to 90% usable value from industrial waste—reintegrated into the supply chain.

India’s solar growth is accelerating, but end-of-life solar panel management is still an emerging
gap. Without proper recycling infrastructure, retired PV modules can become a major solar waste,
compliance, and material-loss challenge.

Entity 4 Recycling Supertech Pvt. Ltd addresses this gap through India-focused solar panel
recycling, PV module recycling, solar panel dismantling, and material recovery systems designed for
the next phase of clean energy.

#### "Sustainability cannot end at the point of installation."

### Building Tomorrow's Solar, Without Tomorrow's Waste

[86f6b1a0a8dada841bb7d83a7aa826e0fd83ed0b.jpg]

#### Our Goal

To ensure the solar energy industry does not create tomorrow’s waste crisis, but builds a circular
and responsible energy ecosystem.


Entity 4 aims to make solar panel recycling in India structured, scalable, and value-driven through
material recovery, CPCB-ready compliance support, and responsible PV module waste management.

#### About us

At Entity 4 Recycling Supertech Pvt. Ltd, we recover usable value from end-of-life solar panels and
return it to the solar and manufacturing supply chain. As part of the wider Entity group ecosystem
behind Entity1 and Entity2, we bring industrial expertise to India’s emerging solar waste challenge
— transforming retired panels into recoverable glass, silicon, aluminium, copper, silver-bearing
fractions, and metals that re-enter productive use.

[LEARN MORE][6]
[b0dee246bd7568a66a0c60448e70b3f1aa07f9f7.jpg]

CRITICAL INFRASTRUCTURE

### Industrial Recovery Solutions

Four precision steps from decommissioned panel to recovered value — designed for industrial scale.

[Frame 1707494770.png]

#SOLARRECYCLING

##### End-of-Life Solar Panel Recycling

End-to-end recycling of retired solar panels reduces landfill waste while recovering valuable
materials for industrial reuse.

[Frame 1707495294.png]

#PVDISMANTLING

##### Advanced Panel Dismantling & Separation

Accurate separation of glass, metals, silicon wafers and polymers ensures high-purity recovery,
maximizing reuse potential.

[Frame 1707495295.png]

#CIRCULARECONOMY

##### Waste-to-Value Material Recovery

Transforms recovered materials into valuable inputs, supporting the circular economy and sustainable
solar manufacturing.

PROCESS

### The E4 SolarLoop™ Recovery Process

Entity4’s E4 SolarLoop™ Recovery Process is designed to move beyond generic scrap handling. It
combines structured collection, precision dismantling, controlled delamination, and
material-specific recovery pathways for PV module recycling and solar panel material recovery

[End -of -life Collection.png]

1

Secure pickup, inventory documentation, and site clearance for decommissioned solar panels across
India.

### Collection

[Precision Dismantling.png]

2

Mechanical removal of aluminium frames, junction boxes, cables, and external components before
deeper material separation.

### Precision Dismantling

[Frame 1707495350.png]

3

Layer-by-layer separation of glass, encapsulant, solar cells, and backing materials to reduce
contamination and improve material quality.

### Controlled Delamination

[Re-Entry into Value Chain.png]

4

Targeted recovery of solar glass, silicon-bearing fractions, aluminium, copper, and silver-bearing
cell material.

### Material Recovery

[Re-Entry into Value Chain.png]

5

Recovered materials are prepared for industrial reuse, resale, or further refining through approved
downstream partners.

### Re-Entry into Value Chain

### Material Recovery, Not Just Waste Handling

###### Glass Recovery

[Glass recovery.jpg.jpeg]

Entity4 uses controlled separation to preserve glass value and reduce mixed-waste contamination.
This helps recovered glass move toward industrial reuse instead of low-value disposal.

###### Silicon Recovery

[silicon recovery.jpg.jpeg]

Solar cells are separated through a process-led recovery pathway that protects silicon-bearing
material from unnecessary crushing and mixed-waste contamination

###### Silver Recovery

[silver recovery.jpg.jpeg]

Silver-bearing cell fractions are isolated for further refining, improving recovery value compared
to generic shredding-based recycling.

[Frame 1707496747.png]

Regulatory Mandate

### India's Solar Waste Rules Are Here.

Under the E-Waste (Management) Rules, manufacturers, producers and recyclers of solar PV must
register with the CPCB, file annual returns, and maintain compliant collection and storage systems.
As India's solar waste volumes surge, compliance is no longer optional — it's a business
requirement.


Entity4 helps solar developers, EPCs and manufacturers meet these obligations — turning a regulatory
requirement into recovered value.

Your Obligations

#### CPCB Compliance Checklist

What every solar asset owner must now manage

## Energy Performance Certificates

An Energy Performance Certificate (EPC) is a crucial legal requirement when selling or renting out a
property. To ensure a smooth marketing process and full compliance with legal standards, it's highly
advisable to obtain your EPC in advance. Having this certificate ready before listing can streamline
the process and help avoid last-minute complications.

Our EPC services are delivered by fully qualified and accredited assessors, ensuring that your EPC
meets all current regulatory standards for both rental and sale properties. Once issued, the
certificate will be officially registered on the EPC register, making it accessible to potential
buyers or tenants. This level of transparency allows interested parties to review and compare the
energy performance of your property with others on the market.

The EPC provides detailed information about your property’s energy consumption and typical energy
costs, along with recommendations for improving energy efficiency. It assigns an energy efficiency
rating from A (most efficient) to G (least efficient), which helps prospective buyers or tenants
gauge the property's overall energy performance.

In addition to fulfilling legal requirements, the EPC offers valuable insights into how you can
reduce energy consumption and save on costs, thereby enhancing your property's appeal. The
certificate remains valid for 10 years, ensuring long-term compliance and ongoing benefits. By
obtaining an EPC, you not only meet your legal obligations but also gain a competitive advantage in
the property market by showcasing your property's energy efficiency.

### Key Information Provided by an Energy Performance Certificate (EPC)

An Energy Performance Certificate (EPC) offers potential homeowners valuable insights into the
energy costs of running a property over three years, based on standard occupancy. It assigns an
energy rating to the property on a scale from A to G, with A being the most efficient and G the
least.

The EPC also includes a list of recommended actions to improve the property’s energy performance.
Common suggestions include:
* Installing Energy-Saving Light Bulbs throughout the house
* Increasing loft insulation depth
* Upgrading to a Condensing Boiler with full heating controls, including a Timer Switch, Room
  Thermostat, and Thermostatic Radiator Valves (TRVs)
* Installing Double Glazing
* Adding Floor and Wall Insulation, depending on the property's construction date

Additionally, the EPC provides a rating of the property’s carbon emissions, also on an A to G scale.
The government reports that approximately 30% of the CO2 emissions in England and Wales are
generated by homes.

### Property Rental Assistance

Since 2008 all private rental properties must have an Energy Performance Certificate (EPC) with an
energy efficiency rating of at least E. .

The Minimum Energy Efficiency Standards (MEES) legislation requires that, as of April 2018,
landlords cannot grant a new tenancy for any property with an Energy Performance Certificate (EPC)
rating below E. Since 2023, this regulation has also applied to existing tenancies.

If your property is currently rated F or G, you may be prohibited from renting it out. Contact us
today for expert advice on how to improve your EPC rating and ensure your property meets the
required energy performance standards.

When we conduct an EPC assessment for MEES compliance, we can also offer expert advice on the
fastest and most cost-effective ways to improve your building's EPC

obtaining an EPC, you not only meet your legal obligations but also gain a competitive advantage in
the property market by showcasing your property's energy efficiency.

### Key Information Provided by an Energy Performance Certificate (EPC)

An Energy Performance Certificate (EPC) offers potential homeowners valuable insights into the
energy costs of running a property over three years, based on standard occupancy. It assigns an
energy rating to the property on a scale from A to G, with A being the most efficient and G the
least.

The EPC also includes a list of recommended actions to improve the property’s energy performance.
Common suggestions include:
* Installing Energy-Saving Light Bulbs throughout the house
* Increasing loft insulation depth
* Upgrading to a Condensing Boiler with full heating controls, including a Timer Switch, Room
  Thermostat, and Thermostatic Radiator Valves (TRVs)
* Installing Double Glazing
* Adding Floor and Wall Insulation, depending on the property's construction date

Additionally, the EPC provides a rating of the property’s carbon emissions, also on an A to G scale.
The government reports that approximately 30% of the CO2 emissions in England and Wales are
generated by homes.

### Property Rental Assistance

Since 2008 all private rental properties must have an Energy Performance Certificate (EPC) with an
energy efficiency rating of at least E. .

The Minimum Energy Efficiency Standards (MEES) legislation requires that, as of April 2018,
landlords cannot grant a new tenancy for any property with an Energy Performance Certificate (EPC)
rating below E. Since 2023, this regulation has also applied to existing tenancies.

If your property is currently rated F or G, you may be prohibited from renting it out. Contact us
today for expert advice on how to improve your EPC rating and ensure your property meets the
required energy performance standards.

When we conduct an EPC assessment for MEES compliance, we can also offer expert advice on the
fastest and most cost-effective ways to improve your building's EPC rating. We can survey your
entire property portfolio—regardless of location or building type—and provide guidance on the
simplest and least disruptive methods to bring your properties up to the required standard.

### Efficient Energy Solutions

An Energy Performance Certificate (EPC) provides a detailed record of a property's energy
efficiency. Whether you're building, selling, renting, or marketing a property, an EPC is a
mandatory requirement. The EPC also includes recommendations to improve your property's energy
performance.

The EPC outlines the energy usage and associated costs of a property, making properties with better
ratings more appealing to potential buyers or tenants due to lower running costs. An EPC is valid
for 10 years, and failure to maintain an up-to-date certificate when marketing can result in fines.
You can receive your EPC directly, download it from the central register, or have it sent to your
solicitor or letting agent upon request.

### About EPC Group

EPC Group is a Microsoft consulting firm founded in 1997 (originally Enterprise Project Consulting,
renamed EPC Group in 2005). 29 years of enterprise Microsoft consulting experience. [EPC Group is a
Microsoft Solutions Partner][37] with all six Solutions Partner Designations — Modern Work, Data &
AI (Azure), Infrastructure (Azure), Digital & App Innovation (Azure), Business Applications, and
Security. EPC Group historically held continuous Microsoft Gold Certified Partner status until the
Gold/Silver tiering framework was retired by Microsoft.

Headquartered at 4900 Woodway Drive, Suite 830, Houston, TX 77056. Public clients include NASA, FBI,
FRBNY (Federal Reserve Bank of New York), Pentagon, United Airlines, PepsiCo, Nike, and Northrop
Grumman. 6,500+ SharePoint implementations, 1,500+ Power BI deployments, Microsoft Fabric
implementations at enterprise scale, 70+ Fortune 500 organizations served, 11,000+ enterprise
engagements. Senior-architect-led delivery teams across the United States.

### About Errin O'Connor

Errin O'Connor is the Founder & Chief AI Architect of EPC Group, Microsoft Gold Partner for multiple
years, first awarded 2003. 4× Microsoft Press bestselling author of Windows SharePoint Services 3.0
Inside Out (2007), Microsoft SharePoint Foundation 2010 Inside Out (2011), SharePoint 2013 Field
Guide (2014), and Microsoft Power BI Dashboards Step by Step (2018).

Original SharePoint Beta Team member (Project Tahoe). Original Power BI Beta Team member (Project
Crescent). Worked with U.S. CIO Vivek Kundra on the Obama administration's 25-Point Plan to reform
federal IT, and with NASA CIO Chris Kemp as Lead Architect on the NASA Nebula Cloud project. Speaker
at Microsoft Ignite, SharePoint Conference, KMWorld, and DATAVERSITY.

Delivering precision-engineered solutions across automotive, appliances, medical, and consumer
industries with specialized expertise and quality standards

Automotive Appliances Medical Devices Consumer Products
[Automotive Manufacturing]

### Automotive Excellence

As a trusted Tier 1 Supplier, we manufacture complex automotive components including instrument
panel assemblies, interior and exterior trim including paint capabilities for major OEMs across
North America.

#### Instrument Panel Assemblies

Complex multi-component instrument panel systems with integrated electronics housing and premium
finish quality.

#### Interior Components

Center consoles, door panels, and trim pieces with advanced materials and Class-A surface finishes.

#### Quality Certified

ISO/TS 16949 certified facilities ensuring automotive quality standards and supply chain
reliability.

### Appliance Manufacturing

Providing durable, high-quality molded components for home appliances with focus on heat resistance,
UV stability, and long-term performance for major appliance manufacturers.

#### Control Panels

Durable control panels for home appliances with heat resistance and UV stability for long-lasting
performance.

#### Appliance Housing

Structural components and housings for major appliances with textured finishes and impact
resistance.

#### High Volume Production

Efficient manufacturing processes for high-volume appliance component production with consistent
quality.

### Medical Device Manufacturing

FDA-compliant cleanroom manufacturing for medical device components, surgical instruments, and
diagnostic equipment housing.

#### Device Housing

Precision housings for diagnostic equipment and medical devices with sterilizable materials.

#### Surgical Components

High-precision components for surgical instruments with stringent quality and safety requirements.

#### FDA Compliant

ISO 13485 certified facilities with cleanroom manufacturing and full regulatory compliance.

### Consumer Products

High-volume manufacturing of consumer product components including appliance parts, electronic
housings, and protective cases with focus on durability and aesthetics.

#### Electronics Housing

Lightweight, durable housings for portable electronics with impact resistance and premium finishes.

#### Appliance Components

Control panels, housings, and structural components for home appliances with UV stability and heat
resistance.

#### Sustainable Materials

Environmentally conscious manufacturing with recycled materials and sustainable production
practices.

State-of-the-art injection molding technology with comprehensive manufacturing services across our
North American facility network

### Injection Molding Range

Complete range of injection molding presses from 25 to 4,400 tons, enabling production from small
precision parts to large automotive components.
* Small Parts (25-100 ton)
* Medium Parts (100-1000 ton)
* Large Parts (1000-4400 ton)

### Advanced Molding Technologies

Specialized molding processes including two-shot molding, overmolding, and insert molding for
complex component requirements.
* Two-Shot Molding
* Insert Molding
* Overmolding

### Quality & Assembly

Comprehensive quality control systems and secondary assembly services ensuring parts meet exact
specifications and delivery requirements.
* Quality Inspection
* Assembly Services
* On-Time Delivery

The EPC Power M System is more than just an inverter, it's a digital power processor engineered for
AI data center infrastructure and grid applications. The EPC Power M System is more than just an
inverter, it's a digital power processor engineered for AI data center infrastructure. When enabled
with our proprietary Agile Grid Forming^{TM} technology, the M System absorbs load volatility in
real time - protecting generators, stabilizing the grid, and keeping AI workloads running without
interruption. High-density SiC modular architecture configures to any datacenter footprint.
Availability >99.5%. Manufactured in the USA.

# Making Modern Vehicle Repair Easier with EPC Knowledge

Learn how to use Electronic Parts Catalog (EPC) systems, diagnostics, and repair tools — simplified
for real workshops and professionals.

[ Explore Guides ][10] [ Learn More ][11]
5,000+ Professionals
Expert Guides
Updated Weekly

## Who We Help

EPC Software serves automotive professionals at every level

### Workshops & Garages

For repair and maintenance

Streamline your daily operations with instant access to accurate parts catalogs, repair diagrams,
and technical specifications for all vehicle makes and models.

### Spare Part Dealers

To manage accurate parts orders

Eliminate order errors and returns by providing customers with precise OEM part numbers,
compatibility checks, and detailed product specifications.

### Dealerships

For OEM-compliant repairs

Maintain manufacturer standards with direct access to official parts catalogs, ensuring warranty
compliance and customer satisfaction with genuine parts.

### Fleet Managers

For predictive maintenance

Optimize fleet uptime with scheduled maintenance planning, bulk parts ordering, and comprehensive
vehicle history tracking across your entire fleet.

### Automotive Institutes

For training future technicians

Equip students with industry-standard tools and real-world parts identification skills using the
same EPC systems they'll use in their professional careers.

## What Is EPC Software?

EPC (Electronic Parts Catalogue) software is a digital tool that organises vehicle parts data for
accurate identification, ordering, and repair. Instead of flipping through manuals, mechanics can
instantly access parts diagrams, VIN-based data, and OEM references, ensuring every repair uses the
right components.

EPC systems combine VIN data, OEM catalogs, and workshop databases to help you identify parts
faster, reduce mistakes, and improve workshop productivity.

## Why EPC Software Matters in Modern Automotive Repair
* Eliminates incorrect parts orders as well as costly errors
* Enhances the efficiency and productivity of technicians
* Integrates with diagnostics to speed troubleshooting
* Keeps the inventory of the workshop accurate and up to date
* Enhances customer confidence and improves satisfaction

EPC tools convert complex repair data into simple and actionable information for each vehicle.

[Technician using EPC software for vehicle diagnostics]

## How EPC Software Works

EPC systems connect multiple data points:

### 1️⃣ Vehicle Identification Data (VIN)

Recognizes exact vehicle configuration.

Start with a VIN for perfect accuracy, or just enter the make, model, and year. This gives the
system the context to find the right part for the job, ensuring compatibility and eliminating
guesswork in parts selection.

### 2️⃣ OEM Catalogs

Provides diagrams, images, and part numbers.

Access comprehensive manufacturer databases with detailed exploded diagrams, high-quality images,
and exact OEM part numbers. This visual reference helps technicians identify components quickly and
order the correct parts every time.

### 3️⃣ Workshop Management Systems

Syncs repair orders and diagnostics.

Seamlessly integrates with your existing workshop software to sync repair orders, diagnostic data,
and inventory systems. This connection streamlines workflow, reduces data entry errors, and keeps
your entire operation synchronized.

The result? Instant, accurate parts lookup for any make or model.

Comprehensive resources for mastering EPC systems and automotive diagnostics

[Read More →][16]

## What Is EPC Software?

EPC (Electronic Parts Catalogue) software is a digital tool that organises vehicle parts data for
accurate identification, ordering, and repair. Instead of flipping through manuals, mechanics can
instantly access parts diagrams, VIN-based data, and OEM references, ensuring every repair uses the
right components.

EPC systems combine VIN data, OEM catalogs, and workshop databases to help you identify parts
faster, reduce mistakes, and improve workshop productivity.

## Why EPC Software Matters in Modern Automotive Repair
* Eliminates incorrect parts orders as well as costly errors
* Enhances the efficiency and productivity of technicians
* Integrates with diagnostics to speed troubleshooting
* Keeps the inventory of the workshop accurate and up to date
* Enhances customer confidence and improves satisfaction

EPC tools convert complex repair data into simple and actionable information for each vehicle.

[Technician using EPC software for vehicle diagnostics]

## How EPC Software Works

EPC systems connect multiple data points:

### 1️⃣ Vehicle Identification Data (VIN)

Recognizes exact vehicle configuration.

Start with a VIN for perfect accuracy, or just enter the make, model, and year. This gives the
system the context to find the right part for the job, ensuring compatibility and eliminating
guesswork in parts selection.

### 2️⃣ OEM Catalogs

Provides diagrams, images, and part numbers.

Access comprehensive manufacturer databases with detailed exploded diagrams, high-quality images,
and exact OEM part numbers. This visual reference helps technicians identify components quickly and
order the correct parts every time.

### 3️⃣ Workshop Management Systems

Syncs repair orders and diagnostics.

Seamlessly integrates with your existing workshop software to sync repair orders, diagnostic data,
and inventory systems. This connection streamlines workflow, reduces data entry errors, and keeps
your entire operation synchronized.

The result? Instant, accurate parts lookup for any make or model.

## Innovating Smart Infrastructure
## for a Connected World

[Contact us today][12]

#### Powering the Future of Smart Infrastructure

Founded in 2004, SRK Tele Energy India Pvt Ltd (Flexsol) has established itself as a global leader
in designing and manufacturing passive telecom infrastructure solutions. With an extensive portfolio
that includes Smart Poles, Mounting Solutions, Enclosures, Camouflages, and Rooftop Solutions, we
have played a crucial role in building robust telecom networks for operators and OEMs worldwide.

As the industry evolves, so do we. Expanding beyond telecom, Flexsol has made significant strides in
the power segment and is now driving innovation in distributed data centers, standalone mini data
centers, and next-generation IoT solutions. Our commitment to engineering excellence and
adaptability ensures that we remain at the forefront of smart infrastructure solutions, empowering a
more connected world.

Join us at MWC 2025 as we showcase our latest advancements, shaping the future of global
connectivity and digital transformation.

### Solutions

[Telecom]
[

#### Telecom

Our Offerings in Telecom ranges from Mounting kits, Enclosures, Smart poles, Monopoles and Rural Low
Cost solution.

][13]
[Data Center]
[

#### Data Center

Our Offerings are focused on Cooling Efficiency for existing Infra and new Offering for Edge
Datacenters.

][14]
[Power]
[

#### Power

We offer Services like EPC model , Hybrid Power Solution and other required infrastructure for the
Power Site.

][15]
[IOT]
[

#### IOT

Our industrial IOT solution, features Industrial Edge for integrating IT into production and using
machine data.

][16]

### Innovation and Sustainability

At the heart of our organization lies a commitment to innovation, which propels our growth and
achievements. With a strong emphasis on research and development, we consistently challenge the
boundaries of engineering to deliver high-performance infrastructure solutions that adapt to the
evolving needs of the telecommunications, energy, and rapidly expanding digital sectors. Our
expertise encompasses the design of smart poles, modular data centers, durable enclosures, and
advanced mounting solutions, all engineered to withstand extreme environmental conditions while
ensuring maximum operational efficiency.

As the world transitions towards edge computing, the Internet of Things, and renewable energy, we
are devoted to developing scalable, energy-efficient, and future-oriented technologies that empower
businesses to run efficiently. Our advanced manufacturing capabilities, rigorous quality standards,
and customer-focused approach fosters sustainable development.

[Contact us today][17]

# When chaos has a path, have a plan.

Let us help you power on with the #1 home generator in the world.

[Get an Estimate ][57]
[Solution Finder ][58]

## Our home generators provide permanent peace of mind. 
* [A homeowner and a dealer looking over a phone together next to a Generac home standby generator]
  
  Expert installers will be your guide
  
  We connect you with Authorized Generac Dealers in your area who can answer your questions and
  recommend the best home standby solution for your needs.
  
  [Learn about installation ][59]
* All you need to know about home standby
  
  We’ve made it easy to learn about the different types and sizes of backup power systems. Find a
  dealer to learn more.
  
  [Find a Dealer ][60]
* [person lounging on their couch in the evening with electricity powering the lights]
  
  Find the right generator for your home
  
  We’re experts in every technical part and feature of our solutions so you don’t have to be. We’ll
  guide you to the right size generator for your needs. 
  
  [Try the Solution Finder ][61]


Your browser does not support the video tag.

## More ways to keep power close at hand.

At Generac, we believe everyone should have the power they need to tackle every chore, store the
power they generate and bring the power they need on-the-go, wherever they go. So, we’ve built a
wide range of products to do just that.  
* Bring the power of Generac on every adventure
  
  We’re proud to support campers, tailgaters and hard workers with portable generator solutions.
  
  [Explore Portable Generators ][62]
* [Generac Home Energy System installed on a house with PWRcell2 and PWRmicro]
  
  Generate, store, and control your energy
  
  With Generac solar power, solar battery storage, and smart home energy management, you can take
  control of your home’s energy—helping to reduce dependence on the grid and support your home
  during outages.
  
  [See Solar Battery Storage ][63]
* [A man using his Generac Power Washer outside on a sunny day.]
  
  Power through chores
  
  From pressure washers to water pumps, support your home and yard with the maintenance tools that
  power through even the toughest jobs.
  
  [Shop Home Maintenance ][64]


Your browser does not support the video tag.

## Be prepared for hurricane season.

From the leader in emergency power and preparedness, Generac offers you a manageable way to guide
you through the storm season. Download our Hurricane Preparedness Guide for more useful information
on the upcoming hurricane season.

[Get an Estimate ][65]
[Hurricane Guide ][66]

## Proud to be powered by Generac.
* Linda C., East Long Meadow, MA
  
  “We had no power for 8 days... I lost everything in my refrigerator and freezer…so we said never
  again. As you get older, you need that peace of mind and we just love our Generac.”
* Jason C., Panama City, FL
  
  “Our Generac generator is what saved our belongings and is what ultimately saved us as a family.
  There was utter chaos and destruction outside, but my home was air conditioned and I had power.”
* Randy W., Panama City, FL
  
  “You never realize the wrath nature can have until you see 155 mph sustained winds. But our
  Generac didn’t let us down; it powered our air conditioner, our fish tank, our refrigerator and
  freezer. Having a Generac gave me peace of mind knowing I had power.”


Your browser does not support the video tag.
[a generac home generator outside a home with a worms eye of grass.]

We’ve worked hard to be your trusted source of power since 1959.

* ##### Grid Forward
  
  Annual Grid Innovator Award

## FAQ'S

[solar panel company in India]
About solar rooftop system

**What are the main components of a grid-connected rooftop solar PV system? **

A grid-connected rooftop solar PV system is made up of several key components that work together to
generate, convert, and manage electricity efficiently. 

At the heart of the system are the solar panels, also known as photovoltaic (PV) modules. These
panels capture sunlight and convert it into direct current (DC) electricity. They are typically
installed on rooftop structures at an optimal angle to maximize energy generation throughout the
day. 

The electricity generated by the panels then flows to an inverter, which is one of the most critical
components of the system. Since most homes and businesses operate on alternating current (AC), the
inverter converts the DC power produced by the panels into usable AC electricity. Modern inverters
also include monitoring features and safety mechanisms to ensure smooth operation. 

Another essential component is the mounting structure, which securely holds solar panels in place on
the rooftop. It is designed to withstand environmental conditions such as wind, rain, and
temperature variations while maintaining the correct tilt and orientation of the panels. 

The system also includes electrical components such as DC and AC cables, junction boxes, and
protection devices. These elements ensure safe transmission of electricity between different
parts of the system and protect it from faults like short circuits or voltage fluctuations.  

A bidirectional or net meter is installed to measure the flow of electricity between the solar
system and the grid. It records both the energy consumed from the grid and the excess energy
exported back to it, enabling net metering benefits. 

In addition, a grid connection is an integral part of the system, allowing seamless interaction
between the solar installation and the utility supply. This ensures that electricity is available
even when solar generation is low or unavailable. 

Finally, many systems include a monitoring system that allows users to track energy generation,
consumption, and system performance in real time. This helps in identifying issues early
and maintaining optimal efficiency. 

Together, these components form a complete and efficient grid-connected rooftop solar PV system,
enabling users to generate clean energy while staying connected to the conventional power supply. 

**How much area is required for a 1 KWP rooftop Solar PV system? ** 

A rooftop solar PV system typically requires around 8 to 10 square meters of shadow-free roof area. 

**Why do I need a shadow-free area for modules?** 

Every solar panel is made up of dozens of small solar cells connected in a series chain, like links
in a rope. When sunlight falls on them, each cell generates a small voltage. Together, they add up
to produce usable electricity. 

A shaded cell works like that blocked lane. It stops producing electricity but still sits in the
series chain. The current that the rest of the sunny cells are trying to push has nowhere to go, so
the entire string of cells is forced to drop down to the level of that one weak, shaded cell. 

The result? A shadow covering just 5% of a panel can reduce its output by 30–50%. 

A solar panel is only as strong as its weakest cell — and a shadow, even a small one from a TV
antenna, a water tank, a bird, or a neighboring building, instantly becomes that weakness. 

This is why a shadow-free area is not a preference — it is a non-negotiable foundation of any
well-designed solar system. 

**What types of roofs are suitable for a rooftop solar (RTS) system? ** 

The roof must support the weight, survive decades of weather, and allow clean, efficient mounting
without leaks or structural damage. 

Most urban homes, commercial buildings, factories, and institutions in India have RCC roofs, making
them the most common and easiest canvas for solar. 

Whereas most large-scale commercial and industrial rooftop solar projects in India sit on metal shed
roofs. 

A roof that can last 25 years should be a fit for a solar system installed on it, because removing
and reinstalling panels to repair a failing roof costs more than the solar system itself. 

Always assess roof age, waterproofing condition, and structural load capacity before the first panel
is placed. A good solar installer evaluates your roof before they ever talk about panels. 

**Will I get constant/same energy from the RTS all year round? ** 

Our solar system is designed and sized using the annual average generation figure — not the best day
or the worst day. Some days you will generate more. On some monsoon days, you will generate a little
less than the sunnier days. But across the full year, a well-sited and well-maintained system
delivers remarkably close to its designed annual output. Your solar system does not promise you the
same energy every day — it promises you the right energy across the year, if you give it a clean
roof and a clear sky.  

**What are the factors affecting power generation? ** 
1. Solar Irradiance — The Master Variable
2. Panel Orientation — Which Way Your Roof Faces
3. Tilt Angle — The Angle at Which Panels Are Mounted
4. Shading — The Most Destructive Factor Per Unit Area
5. Dust, Soiling and Panel Cleanliness

About solar rooftop system

**What are the main components of a grid-connected rooftop solar PV system? **

A grid-connected rooftop solar PV system is made up of several key components that work together to
generate, convert, and manage electricity efficiently. 

At the heart of the system are the solar panels, also known as photovoltaic (PV) modules. These
panels capture sunlight and convert it into direct current (DC) electricity. They are typically
installed on rooftop structures at an optimal angle to maximize energy generation throughout the
day. 

The electricity generated by the panels then flows to an inverter, which is one of the most critical
components of the system. Since most homes and businesses operate on alternating current (AC), the
inverter converts the DC power produced by the panels into usable AC electricity. Modern inverters
also include monitoring features and safety mechanisms to ensure smooth operation. 

Another essential component is the mounting structure, which securely holds solar panels in place on
the rooftop. It is designed to withstand environmental conditions such as wind, rain, and
temperature variations while maintaining the correct tilt and orientation of the panels. 

The system also includes electrical components such as DC and AC cables, junction boxes, and
protection devices. These elements ensure safe transmission of electricity between different
parts of the system and protect it from faults like short circuits or voltage fluctuations.  

A bidirectional or net meter is installed to measure the flow of electricity between the solar
system and the grid. It records both the energy consumed from the grid and the excess energy
exported back to it, enabling net metering benefits. 

In addition, a grid connection is an integral part of the system, allowing seamless interaction
between the solar installation and the utility supply. This ensures that electricity is available
even when solar generation is low or unavailable. 

Finally, many systems include a monitoring system that allows users to track energy generation,
consumption, and system performance in real time. This helps in identifying issues early
and maintaining optimal efficiency. 

Together, these components form a complete and efficient grid-connected rooftop solar PV system,
enabling users to generate clean energy while staying connected to the conventional power supply. 

**How much area is required for a 1 KWP rooftop Solar PV system? ** 

A rooftop solar PV system typically requires around 8 to 10 square meters of shadow-free roof area. 

**Why do I need a shadow-free area for modules?** 

Every solar panel is made up of dozens of small solar cells connected in a series chain, like links
in a rope. When sunlight falls on them, each cell generates a small voltage. Together, they add up
to produce usable electricity. 

A shaded cell works like that blocked lane. It stops producing electricity but still sits in the
series chain. The current that the rest of the sunny cells are trying to push has nowhere to go, so
the entire string of cells is forced to drop down to the level of that one weak, shaded cell. 

The result? A shadow covering just 5% of a panel can reduce its output by 30–50%. 

A solar panel is only as strong as its weakest cell — and a shadow, even a small one from a TV
antenna, a water tank, a bird, or a neighboring building, instantly becomes that weakness. 

This is why a shadow-free area is not a preference — it is a non-negotiable foundation of any
well-designed solar system. 

**What types of roofs are suitable for a rooftop solar (RTS) system? ** 

The roof must support the weight, survive decades of weather, and allow clean, efficient mounting
without leaks or structural damage. 

Most urban homes, commercial buildings, factories, and institutions in India have RCC roofs, making
them the most common and easiest canvas for solar. 

Whereas most large-scale commercial and industrial rooftop solar projects in India sit on metal shed
roofs. 

A roof that can last 25 years should be a fit for a solar system installed on it, because removing
and reinstalling panels to repair a failing roof costs more than the solar system itself. 

Always assess roof age, waterproofing condition, and structural load capacity before the first panel
is placed. A good solar installer evaluates your roof before they ever talk about panels. 

**Will I get constant/same energy from the RTS all year round? ** 

Our solar system is designed and sized using the annual average generation figure — not the best day
or the worst day. Some days you will generate more. On some monsoon days, you will generate a little
less than the sunnier days. But across the full year, a well-sited and well-maintained system
delivers remarkably close to its designed annual output. Your solar system does not promise you the
same energy every day — it promises you the right energy across the year, if you give it a clean
roof and a clear sky.  

**What are the factors affecting power generation? ** 
1. Solar Irradiance — The Master Variable
2. Panel Orientation — Which Way Your Roof Faces
3. Tilt Angle — The Angle at Which Panels Are Mounted
4. Shading — The Most Destructive Factor Per Unit Area
5. Dust, Soiling and Panel Cleanliness

* Cables (AC/DC), connectors, conduits

#### [Complete BOM and Solar Procurement Services][15]

We assist EPC companies, installers, and developers by providing:
* A complete and accurate Bill of Materials for solar projects

* Vendor coordination and cost optimization

project—from concept to commissioning. Our EPC capabilities cover:
* Industrial and commercial rooftops
* Ground-mounted solar projects
* Customized system design and engineering
* Project management and quality assurance

manifests. With this data we can track vessels, U.S. ports, shippers, consignees, and manifests. Our

[Inven founders]
Ekku, Niilo, and Tommi
Co-founders, Inven

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

Since then, we’ve worked with 1,000+ M&A teams and spoken to thousands of professionals across
private equity, investment banking, consulting, and corporate development.

The core workflow is still the same — analyzing markets, finding the right companies, understanding
them, and reaching the right people. What’s changed is how it gets done.

That’s what we’re continuing to build: grounded in real data, shaped in close collaboration with the
teams doing the work, and evolving rapidly.

## Featured Programs and Rebates

Program

### Level Pay

Monthly billing is here! Level Pay is a new, convenient monthly bill payment option that helps you
budget for your LADWP bill and pay off past due amounts.

[ Learn more ][71]
Program

### Landscape Efficiency Assistance Program

Free services for lawn removal and replacement with California Friendly® landscaping.

[ Learn more ][72]
Program

### EZ Save

The EZ-SAVE Program helps income-qualified customers save on their LADWP bills.

[ Learn more ][73]
Program

### Solar Programs

A key element of LADWP’s renewable energy program is the development of local solar, particularly
customer based programs that tap into the city’s abundant sunshine and provide residents and
businesses with the ability to generate their own power.

[ Learn more ][74]
Program

### Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP)

Helps eligible income-qualified households to manage and meet their immediate home heating and/or
cooling needs.

[ Learn more ][75]
Program

### Senior Citizen / Disability Lifeline Rate

The Lifeline Rate Program is a City of LA Office of Finance program that offers senior and disabled
citizens an exemption on their electric and other utility bills. This rate is available under
provisions of the Los Angeles Municipal Code or the Revenue and Taxation Code of the State of
California.

[ Learn more ][76]
Program

### Cool LA

Cool LA is designed to help LADWP customers better manage the impacts of extreme heat caused by
climate change, especially older adults, income-qualified families, and those living in underserved
communities where hot weather has an especially significant impact.

[ Learn more ][77]
Program

### Water Insights

LADWP’s My Water Insights is a free home water management program designed to help customers better
understand their water use through home water reports and a user-friendly online portal.

[ Learn more ][78]

### Residential Services

Everything you need to know about your residential water and power services.

[ All residential services ][79]

Tailored programs and services to help support the success of your growing business.

[ All commercial services ][80]

### Construction Services

Department expertise and resources designed to inform and help you meet your construction needs.

[ All construction services ][81]

### Doing Business with LADWP

Programs and resources designed to support your business needs.

[ All contractor and developer services ][82]

### LADWP's Summer of Soccer

Stay cool and connected this summer. From powering the games to hydrating fans, learn how LADWP is
keeping the City of Los Angeles ready for every World Cup moment.

[ Learn more ][83]

### Level Pay

Monthly billing is here! Level Pay is a new, convenient monthly bill payment option that helps you
budget for your LADWP bill and pay off past due amounts.

[ Learn more ][71]
Program

### Landscape Efficiency Assistance Program

Free services for lawn removal and replacement with California Friendly® landscaping.

[ Learn more ][72]
Program

### EZ Save

The EZ-SAVE Program helps income-qualified customers save on their LADWP bills.

[ Learn more ][73]
Program

### Solar Programs

A key element of LADWP’s renewable energy program is the development of local solar, particularly
customer based programs that tap into the city’s abundant sunshine and provide residents and
businesses with the ability to generate their own power.

[ Learn more ][74]
Program

### Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP)

Helps eligible income-qualified households to manage and meet their immediate home heating and/or
cooling needs.

[ Learn more ][75]
Program

### Senior Citizen / Disability Lifeline Rate

The Lifeline Rate Program is a City of LA Office of Finance program that offers senior and disabled
citizens an exemption on their electric and other utility bills. This rate is available under
provisions of the Los Angeles Municipal Code or the Revenue and Taxation Code of the State of
California.

[ Learn more ][76]
Program

### Cool LA

Cool LA is designed to help LADWP customers better manage the impacts of extreme heat caused by
climate change, especially older adults, income-qualified families, and those living in underserved
communities where hot weather has an especially significant impact.

[ Learn more ][77]

### Water Insights

LADWP’s My Water Insights is a free home water management program designed to help customers better
understand their water use through home water reports and a user-friendly online portal.

# The Legacy

Since our inception in **1966**, Mahati has been a cornerstone in the power sector, shaping the
industry's evolution through innovation, precision engineering, and unwavering commitment to
excellence. With a legacy spanning five decades, we have built a reputation for delivering
**world-class transformers, reactors, and turnkey power solutions** that power industries,
infrastructure, and communities.

[ Know more ][68]
[Our founder, Shri Udaybabu Shah, standing in front of a large industrial transformer inside Mahati
Industries' factory, along with our esteemed team members.]
[Aerial view of Mahati Industries' industrial facility with a large green and white building at
Yavat, Maharashtra, adjacent to agricultural fields and a highway with several trucks and vehicles.]

Engineering breakthroughs, technological advancements, and a relentless pursuit of quality have
defined our journey. From pioneering extra-high-voltage transformer solutions to expanding our
footprint in global energy projects, Mahati has continually set benchmarks in reliability and
performance. With a strong foundation built on expertise and trust, we continue to evolve, ensuring
our legacy is preserved and strengthened for future generations.

### How can we help?

Mahati is trusted by industries worldwide for delivering reliable, precision-engineered power
solutions. Please share your requirements, and our team will be ready to assist you.

[Mahati's team of workers, some wearing yellow safety helmets, standing in front of our industries

# The Legacy

Since our inception in **1966**, Mahati has been a cornerstone in the power sector, shaping the
industry's evolution through innovation, precision engineering, and unwavering commitment to
excellence. With a legacy spanning five decades, we have built a reputation for delivering
**world-class transformers, reactors, and turnkey power solutions** that power industries,
infrastructure, and communities.

[ Know more ][68]

Industries' factory, along with our esteemed team members.]
[Aerial view of Mahati Industries' industrial facility with a large green and white building at
Yavat, Maharashtra, adjacent to agricultural fields and a highway with several trucks and vehicles.]

Engineering breakthroughs, technological advancements, and a relentless pursuit of quality have
defined our journey. From pioneering extra-high-voltage transformer solutions to expanding our
footprint in global energy projects, Mahati has continually set benchmarks in reliability and
performance. With a strong foundation built on expertise and trust, we continue to evolve, ensuring
our legacy is preserved and strengthened for future generations.

Mahati is trusted by industries worldwide for delivering reliable, precision-engineered power

## Home

[mbh16][66]2024-09-16T10:10:13+00:00

###### ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 Certified

Partners in Progress…..

MBH Power Group is a total energy solutions company providing world-class services to meet the
growing demand of the power sector in emerging markets. It focuses on EPC solutions in Transmission
and Distribution, Metering & Energy Audit and Turnkey solutions in Conventional & Non-Conventional
Power Generation. having its Head Quarter at Singapore

Foundation of company’s growth over the years is expertise and deep understanding of power industry,
importance of energy and ability to translate them into socially and economically desired solutions
through leading edge technology and highly skilled human resources.

MBH power was incorporated as a Limited Company to provide premium services to energy sector of the
country and commenced operations in the year 2000. Also expanding its international footprints,
established through power contracts and supplies since its inception, today MBH is spread over
Singapore, UAE, India, Tanzania, Liberia, Niger, Uganda, Rwanda, Zambia, Gambia, Cameroon, Senegal,
Togo, Guinea Nigeria and Ghana. With the foundation of its rich experience, MBH Power today is
heading towards exploring opportunities to enlighten future generations

###### ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 Certified

Partners in Progress…..

MBH Power Group is a total energy solutions company providing world-class services to meet the
growing demand of the power sector in emerging markets. It focuses on EPC solutions in Transmission
and Distribution, Metering & Energy Audit and Turnkey solutions in Conventional & Non-Conventional
Power Generation. having its Head Quarter at Singapore

Foundation of company’s growth over the years is expertise and deep understanding of power industry,
importance of energy and ability to translate them into socially and economically desired solutions
through leading edge technology and highly skilled human resources.

MBH power was incorporated as a Limited Company to provide premium services to energy sector of the
country and commenced operations in the year 2000. Also expanding its international footprints,
established through power contracts and supplies since its inception, today MBH is spread over
Singapore, UAE, India, Tanzania, Liberia, Niger, Uganda, Rwanda, Zambia, Gambia, Cameroon, Senegal,
Togo, Guinea Nigeria and Ghana. With the foundation of its rich experience, MBH Power today is
heading towards exploring opportunities to enlighten future generations

### Powering Global ConnectionsReliable Wiring Harness Solutions

###### Delivering high-quality cable and wiring solutions for global industries.

## Rugged Power, Reliable Connectivity for Off-Highway and Industrial Vehicles

Trusted global manufacturer of wiring harnesses, battery cables and complete electrical systems
engineered for demanding off-highway environments – built on decades of expertise, precision
manufacturing and vertical integration.

[Talk to a solutions expert][8]

## What We Do – Our Solutions

Purpose-built Off-Highway electrical systems

From concept to full production, we provide OEMs and Tier-1 partners with engineered power and
connectivity solutions that perform in harsh environments – vibration, moisture, dust and
temperature extremes.

## Core Capabilities

**Our core capabilities combine robust design, proven manufacturing and end-to-end integration to
support demanding Off-Highway and industrial applications:**
* Ruggedised wiring harnesses and cable assemblies
* Battery and power cable assemblies
* High-voltage power distribution modules
* Custom assemblies and systems integration
* Durable connectors, fuse boxes and busbars
* Prototyping, testing and scalable production

**[Wiring Harnesses & Cable Assembly][9]
**

**

[**Fuse Boxes**][11]

[**Battery Cables**][12]

**

[**Integrated Manufacturing Services (IMS)**][14]

## MT | Volex Highlights

MT | Volex combines proven engineering expertise with the strength of Volex’s global manufacturing
network. Our solutions are designed for reliability, durability and consistent performance in
demanding off-highway environments. With vertically integrated production and rigorous quality
standards, we help customers reduce risk, improve efficiency and accelerate time to market.

Decades of manufacturing know-how and engineering excellence

Vertically integrated production for speed and quality control

Built for harsh off-highway conditions – durability without compromise

Close alignment with global markets and customer needs via Volex networks

OEM and Tier-1 trusted partner

[About Volex Off-Highway Capabilities][15]

## Applications We Serve

Our power and connectivity solutions support a wide range of off-highway and industrial vehicle
platforms operating in harsh conditions. From heavy equipment to specialised machinery, MT | Volex
delivers electrical systems engineered for performance, safety and long-term reliability across
diverse industries and operating environments.

## Ideal for

**Agricultural Machinery**

**Construction  Equipment**

**Mining Vehicles**

**Forestry and Utility Equipment**

**Heavy Trucks and Specialty Transport**

**Public Transportation and Mass Transit Electrification
**

**Lift Trucks**

## Locations

MT | Volex operates within a strategically aligned manufacturing footprint built to support
scalability, consistent quality and responsive supply. Our 6 MT | Volex factories – alongside 2
additional Volex facilities dedicated to the Off-Highway market – are part of Volex’s broader global
network of 23 manufacturing sites.

Our facilities are structured to meet demanding production requirements while maintaining rigorous
quality and operational standards. This manufacturing foundation enables reliable programme
execution, supply continuity and close alignment with customer needs across global markets.

# Innovative Solutions For
# **A Sustainable Future**

NMDC Group is an integrated energy and marine services, engineering, procurement, and construction
(EPC) organization with a footprint spanning the MENA region, South Asia, and beyond. We work on
highly ambitious projects, delivering innovative solutions to even the most complex challenges.

[ About Us ][40]

## About NMDC Group

NMDC Group is a prominent figure in the fields of engineering, marine dredging, procurement, and
construction, working in the Middle East and further afield.

We specialize in providing innovative solutions for those vital sectors at the core of the UAE
economy. This includes addressing the complex future challenges facing the energy EPC sector.

Under our umbrella, we own and operate five business units: NMDC Dredging & Marine, NMDC Energy,
NMDC Infra, NMDC Engineering, and NMDC LTS.

[ Read More About NMDC Group ][41]

## Business Units

### NMDC Dredging & Marine

Leading the field of marine dredging, reclamation, and construction, NMDC Dredging & Marine delivers
projects of superior quality. With years of international experience, we are known for our
exceptional track record and commitment to generating true value for all stakeholders.

[ Visit Website ][42]

### NMDC Energy

NMDC Energy is focused on providing engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) solutions to
the energy sector. With comprehensive services tailored to both offshore and onshore clients in the
oil & gas and energy industries, NMDC Energy is designed to continuously meet the industry’s
challenges.

[ Visit Website ][43]

### NMDC Engineering

A leading coastal and marine engineering consultancy, NMDC Engineering has experience working across
marine, civil, hydraulics, geotechnical, and environmental engineering. Across the Arabian Gulf and
the Middle East, NMDC Engineering is enabling the completion of some of the largest marine,
waterfront, and oil & gas infrastructure.

[ Visit Website ][44]

### NMDC Infra

A pioneering construction technology business, NMDC Infra is leading the way when it comes to
precast concrete. With cutting-edge technology and extensive experience, we offer complete,
sustainable, and affordable precast solutions for all construction products, delivering a wide range
of structural and architectural elements.

[ Visit Website ][45]

### NMDC LTS

NMDC LTS (NMDC Logistics & Technical Services) delivers industry-leading support for complex
infrastructure projects, leveraging decades of EPC expertise to ensure seamless execution. With a
solution-driven approach, we drive operational excellence and efficiency across the construction and
industrial sectors, facilitating sustainable growth.

# Innovative Solutions For
# **A Sustainable Future**

NMDC Group is an integrated energy and marine services, engineering, procurement, and construction
(EPC) organization with a footprint spanning the MENA region, South Asia, and beyond. We work on
highly ambitious projects, delivering innovative solutions to even the most complex challenges.

[ About Us ][40]

## About NMDC Group

NMDC Group is a prominent figure in the fields of engineering, marine dredging, procurement, and
construction, working in the Middle East and further afield.

We specialize in providing innovative solutions for those vital sectors at the core of the UAE
economy. This includes addressing the complex future challenges facing the energy EPC sector.

Under our umbrella, we own and operate five business units: NMDC Dredging & Marine, NMDC Energy,
NMDC Infra, NMDC Engineering, and NMDC LTS.

[ Read More About NMDC Group ][41]

## Business Units

### NMDC Dredging & Marine

Leading the field of marine dredging, reclamation, and construction, NMDC Dredging & Marine delivers
projects of superior quality. With years of international experience, we are known for our
exceptional track record and commitment to generating true value for all stakeholders.

[ Visit Website ][42]

### NMDC Energy

NMDC Energy is focused on providing engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) solutions to
the energy sector. With comprehensive services tailored to both offshore and onshore clients in the
oil & gas and energy industries, NMDC Energy is designed to continuously meet the industry’s
challenges.

[ Visit Website ][43]

### NMDC Engineering

A leading coastal and marine engineering consultancy, NMDC Engineering has experience working across
marine, civil, hydraulics, geotechnical, and environmental engineering. Across the Arabian Gulf and
the Middle East, NMDC Engineering is enabling the completion of some of the largest marine,
waterfront, and oil & gas infrastructure.

[ Visit Website ][44]

### NMDC Infra

A pioneering construction technology business, NMDC Infra is leading the way when it comes to
precast concrete. With cutting-edge technology and extensive experience, we offer complete,
sustainable, and affordable precast solutions for all construction products, delivering a wide range
of structural and architectural elements.

[ Visit Website ][45]

### NMDC LTS

NMDC LTS (NMDC Logistics & Technical Services) delivers industry-leading support for complex
infrastructure projects, leveraging decades of EPC expertise to ensure seamless execution. With a
solution-driven approach, we drive operational excellence and efficiency across the construction and
industrial sectors, facilitating sustainable growth.

#### across Türkiye, Europe, and the United States.

We are an infrastructure development and engineering firm headquartered in Türkiye and the United
States. We work across the full lifecycle of renewable power plants, battery energy storage systems,

* Procurement and Equipment Supply
  
  ODN Energy operates a procurement function that ranges from supplying a single transformer to
  running a full multi-package competitive tender. We support clients with item-level procurement,
  end-to-end purchasing management, tender administration, and consolidated bulk purchasing where
  scale produces meaningful pricing advantage.
  
  Through long-standing partnerships with manufacturers in Europe and Asia, we supply power and
  distribution transformers, dry-type and data center transformers, battery energy storage systems
  (BESS), PV modules, e-houses, mobile substations, modular data center solutions, LV and MCC
  panels, data center cabinets, medium- and low-voltage electrical equipment, power and
  communication cables, transmission towers and conductors, and high-pressure fogging and
  evaporative cooling systems. Every package is delivered with factory documentation, traceability
  records, warranty coverage, and local commissioning assistance.
* Installation and Construction
  
  ODN Energy self-performs and manages the construction of the assets it engineers and procures,
  closing the gap between design intent and a commissioned plant. We deliver installation and
  construction for utility-scale solar (SPP) and wind plants, battery energy storage systems,
  high-voltage substations, industrial facilities, and data centers either as a full EPC scope or as
  a balance-of-plant and electrical installation contractor working alongside the owner's other
  trades.
  
  The scope covers civil and structural works, mechanical and electrical (M&E) installation,
  mounting structures and module installation, BESS and e-house placement, MV/LV cabling and
  terminations, substation erection, transformer and switchgear installation, grounding and
  lightning protection, testing, energization, and commissioning. Each site is run by ODN Energy
  site managers and licensed engineers against a single HSE and quality plan, with progress, cost,
  and schedule reported to the client and lenders on one cadence.
  
  Because the same firm engineers, procures, and builds, design changes are absorbed internally
  rather than turned into contractual claims which is what keeps schedule and budget predictable
  from groundbreaking to energization.
* Owner's Engineering and Project Management
  
  For clients who are developing or financing projects but do not want to staff a full technical
  team, ODN Energy serves as the owner's engineer across power plants, data centers, energy storage
  systems, substations, and transmission lines. The role covers technology selection, design review,
  EPC contract structuring and tender management advisory, third-party Factory Acceptance Testing
  (FAT), construction supervision, and commissioning oversight.
  
  We also run full project management mandates where ODN Energy holds the program plan, manages the
  contractor interfaces, controls cost and schedule, and reports to the client and lenders. This is
  the engagement model investors and corporate owners use when they need execution accountability
  without taking on the staffing burden of an in-house EPC team.
* Strategic Advisory: Market Entry and M&A
  
  As clients expand into new geographies, ODN Energy provides business development advisory for
  entry into Middle East, Africa, European, and American renewable energy markets. The work covers
  regulatory and grid environment assessment, partner and counterparty mapping, route-to-market
  design, local entity structuring, and the first wave of project origination on the ground.
  
  We also advise on mergers and acquisitions for renewable energy projects, supporting buy-side and
  sell-side mandates through technical due diligence, commercial valuation, equipment and EPC
  quality assessment, and post-acquisition integration planning. Our M&A work is grounded in
  operational engineering experience, which is what allows us to surface the technical risks pure
  financial advisors typically miss.

### **Products**

ODN Energy supplies the core equipment classes behind power plants, energy storage, transmission &
distribution, and data center infrastructure sourced directly from certified manufacturers in the
U.S., Europe and Asia, delivered with full factory documentation, and backed by on-site
commissioning support. Every product line below can be procured as a single item or integrated into
a turnkey ODN Energy scope.

[Two large white shipping containers on flatbed trucks parked on a paved road near a grassy field
and a playground area.]

**E-House**

ODN Energy supplies prefabricated E-House (Electrical House) solutions for rapid and reliable
electrical infrastructure deployment at project sites. These self-contained, factory-assembled
structures house medium-voltage/low-voltage switchgear, transformers, and control and automation
equipment within a single insulated enclosure significantly reducing on-site installation time for
power plants, data centers, and industrial facilities.

Fully equipped at the factory and designed for plug-and-play commissioning upon delivery, E-Houses
are engineered for both indoor and outdoor applications. ODN Energy manages the full supply and
installation coordination of customized E-House solutions tailored to each project's voltage level,
capacity requirements, and environmental conditions.

[ODN_Mobile_Substation]

**Mobile Substation**

Mobile substations are fully equipped, road-transportable electrical systems designed for rapid
power infrastructure deployment in emergency situations, temporary connection points, or remote
project sites. They consolidate high- and medium-voltage components, transformers, and protection
equipment onto a single trailer or skid platform.

ODN Energy supplies and deploys mobile substations to ensure uninterrupted power supply during the
construction phase of new sites or to provide temporary feeding during maintenance windows on
existing systems. Available in a wide range of voltage levels and power capacities, each unit is
configured to match specific project and grid requirements.

[Electrical transformers and equipment installed outdoors on a power substation with a clear blue
sky in the background.]

**Transformers**

**Power transformers** perform voltage conversion between high-voltage transmission lines and
distribution networks, used in large-scale power plant grid connections, transmission projects, and
substations. Available from 5 MVA to 250 MVA across voltage levels from 72.5 kV up to 420 kV, with
on-load tap changer (OLTC) options and ONAN/ONAF oil cooling.

**Dry-type (cast resin) transformers** use air instead of oil as the cooling and insulation medium,
making them maintenance-free and significantly safer in fire terms than oil-immersed alternatives.
They are the preferred solution for indoor installations, densely populated areas, data centers, and
multi-story buildings, available from 25 kVA to 25,000 kVA up to 36 kV.

**Fogging System**

ODN Energy supplies and integrates high-pressure inlet fogging systems for gas turbines, used to
recover the output and efficiency that turbines lose as ambient temperature rises. Fine atomized
water injected into the inlet air stream evaporates and cools the air, increasing air density and
restoring or, with wet compression, augmenting turbine power output. The systems are OEM-compatible
and suited to both simple- and combined-cycle plants and peaking operation.

power infrastructure deployment in emergency situations, temporary connection points, or remote
project sites. They consolidate high- and medium-voltage components, transformers, and protection

configured to match specific project and grid requirements.

distribution networks, used in large-scale power plant grid connections, transmission projects, and
substations. Available from 5 MVA to 250 MVA across voltage levels from 72.5 kV up to 420 kV, with
on-load tap changer (OLTC) options and ONAN/ONAF oil cooling.
