making them maintenance-free and significantly safer in fire terms than oil-immersed alternatives.
They are the preferred solution for indoor installations, densely populated areas, data centers, and
multi-story buildings, available from 25 kVA to 25,000 kVA up to 36 kV.

water injected into the inlet air stream evaporates and cools the air, increasing air density and
restoring or, with wet compression, augmenting turbine power output. The systems are OEM-compatible

# OMOGLE — AI Face Rating & Mog Battle Arena

Omogle is the next-generation platform for competitive face analysis. Our neural network analyzes
468 points of your face, calculates an aesthetic rating, and lets you compete against real people in
real-time video battles.

## How Omogle Works

### Step 1: Face Scan

Our neural network builds a 3D map of your face using 468 landmark points, analyzing symmetry,
proportions, jawline definition, canthal tilt, and skin quality in real time. The TensorFlow Face
Mesh model processes everything directly in your browser, ensuring your photos are never uploaded to
external servers.

### Step 2: 1v1 Battle

The matchmaking system pairs you with an opponent based on ELO rating. Over 10 seconds, the AI
simultaneously evaluates both participants through live video. The winner is determined by comparing
composite scores across six facial metrics: symmetry, jawline, eyes, nose, skin quality, and overall
proportions.

### Step 3: Rank & Grow

Win battles, climb the global leaderboard, and track your progress over time. The platform features
8 professional tiers from Bronze to Ethereal, each reflecting your competitive standing. Use
personalized PSL report recommendations to improve your scores between matches.

## Why Choose Omogle

We combined cutting-edge AI analysis with competitive gameplay to build a one-of-a-kind platform for
objective facial aesthetics evaluation. Here is what makes Omogle different from other face rating
tools:
* **468-Point 3D Analysis:** The most accurate Face Mesh technology powered by TensorFlow. The
  algorithm measures proportions against the golden ratio, evaluates facial symmetry, and analyzes
  the geometry of every facial zone.
* **Real-time PvP Arena:** Compete against real people in real time via WebRTC. Video chat and
  instant AI analysis happen directly in your browser with zero latency.
* **ELO Rating System:** A professional rating system similar to chess. Your ELO rises with wins and
  falls with losses. 8 tiers from Bronze to Ethereal reflect your progress.
* **Complete Privacy:** Your photos are never stored on our servers. All analysis runs locally in
  your browser via WebGL. We do not store or share your images with any third parties.
* **PSL Report & Advice:** Get a detailed breakdown of every parameter: symmetry, jawline, eyes,
  nose, and skin. Each metric comes with personalized recommendations for improvement.
* **Community Voting:** Beyond AI scoring, users vote for the best. Community rating creates a
  separate leaderboard that reflects the objective opinion of real people.

## What is a Mog Battle?

A Mog Battle is a competition format where two people are compared on facial aesthetic parameters.
The term "mog" (from "mogging") refers to surpassing someone in appearance. In the context of our
platform, it is an objective and fair way to see how your face is evaluated by computer vision
algorithms.

Omogle uses TensorFlow Face Mesh technology to build a 3D mesh of 468 facial keypoints. The
algorithm measures distances between points, calculates angles and proportions, then compares
results against standards of aesthetic harmony — such as the golden ratio (1.618) and ideal facial
proportions used in aesthetic medicine.

Unlike simple beauty filters, our analysis is based on anthropometric data and principles of
aesthetic medicine. The assessment covers six key categories: facial symmetry, jawline structure,
eye shape and canthal tilt, nose proportions, and skin condition. Each category is scored
individually and combined into a total aesthetic rating.

## What is Looksmaxxing?

Looksmaxxing is a systematic approach to improving appearance based on scientific principles. It
includes skincare routines, posture correction, facial exercises (mewing), proper nutrition, and
fitness. The goal is to maximize your natural potential and achieve the best version of yourself.

On Omogle, you can track your looksmaxxing progress using objective AI metrics. Take regular scans,
compare results over time, and use personalized recommendations from PSL reports to achieve better
outcomes. Our community of users shares tips, progress photos, and motivation to help each other
improve.

Our platform supports multiple modes: Solo Test for personal analysis without competition, 1v1
Battle for head-to-head matchups with ELO ranking, Photo Upload for analyzing any image offline, and
Community Voting where real users rate each other in an anonymous format.

### Explore Omogle

* [About — Omogle Technology & Comparison][2]
* [Looksmaxxing Guide — Skincare, Mewing & More][3]
* [Terms of Use][4]
* [Privacy Policy][5]

© 2026 Omogle. The leading AI platform for aesthetic evaluation and real-time competition.

«Using traditional methods, I often found that it would take a lot of time, and a simple change

Jake SteelePrincipal Consultant at SolarFarm Feasibility

Johan Janse van RensburgSolar PV Engineer at Mulilo
[RES Group]

«When manually doing a preliminary site layout in AutoCAD, it can take considerable **time and

single scenario. RatedPower’s ability to **export layouts as DWG files** ensures smooth integration

Isabelle Gezer Renewable Enery Consultant at RES Group

## About Rolls Battery

#### History

Established in 1935, Surrette Battery Company Ltd. is proud to be one of North America’s leading
lead-acid battery producers and Canada’s only remaining independent battery manufacturer. Since
1959, the company has been located in Springhill, Nova Scotia, where we produce a wide range of
Rolls-branded premium deep cycle batteries for use in Renewable Energy, Marine, Motive Power and
Railroad applications. Rolls flooded and sealed AGM & GEL VRLA products are internationally
recognized for their dependability, cycle life and outstanding quality.

#### Availability

Rolls Batteries are sold exclusively via our valued distributors & battery dealers. As a
longstanding manufacturer, Surrette Battery Company has been successful in negotiating and
establishing key partnerships with leading battery distributors and dealers throughout North America
and around the World. Due to product specifications and weight, these agreements and the ability to
ship and warehouse in large volumes have allowed us to improve lead times and minimize the
associated freight costs, improving access and delivery to product for dealers and their customers.

#### Manufacturing

Surrette Battery Company Ltd. manufacturing plant is an ISO registered facility where safety is as
important as product quality. Meeting the needs of our distributors who serve growing Renewable
Energy and Motive Power markets around the globe, we’ve completed numerous expansions and upgrades
in recent years and continue to advance our manufacturing facility and processes to meet demand.

We take pride in our reputation as industry leaders in providing high quality, dependable products
and see customer satisfaction and support as the key to future success. Rigorous inspection and
testing ensure that each battery will deliver the performance our customers have come to expect of
the Rolls brand.

## How It Works

#### 1. Search

Find products via Keyword or Image search.

#### 2. Add to List

Add items to your Procurement List.

#### 3. Submit

We verify stock & shipping costs.

#### 4. Pay

Confirm Proforma Invoice & Pay (T/T).

#### 5. Ship

We inspect, consolidate & ship to door.

Need help sourcing custom products?

[[email protected]][19]

## Frequently Asked Questions

Do you ship worldwide?

Yes, we ship to over 200 countries via Sea (FCL/LCL), Air Cargo, Express (DHL/UPS), or Rail.

Can I get samples before bulk order?

Yes. You can add a single item to your procurement list as a sample request. We will consolidate
samples from multiple factories to save shipping costs.

Can you source custom products (OEM)?

Absolutely. Send us your design drawings or technical requirements, and we will find a qualified
factory to manufacture it for you.

founded by IIT alumni and focused on delivering high-performance solar solutions for commercial and
industrial businesses. We provide end-to-end commercial solar EPC for business, covering design,
engineering, installation, and long-term operation and maintenance that are built to reduce
electricity costs and deliver predictable ROI. Businesses with Sun Photonics typically save 35–45%
on electricity bills with our solar systems

**Discover How Much Your Business Can Save With Solar **

[Book Your Free Site Visit][34]

From rooftop and ground-mounted solar to grid-connected, off-grid, and green open access projects,
our systems are engineered for factories, warehouses, and large commercial facilities that demand
reliability at scale. With a fully in-house EPC and O&M team, regulatory compliance, and flexible
CAPEX and OPEX models, we make clean energy financially viable for businesses of every size.

**Sun Photonics designs solar systems that put your power costs under control.**
**Stop paying the grid. Let the sun pay your electricity bills.**

## Solar Services

One contractor. Full accountability. A turnkey solar EPC model covers design, engineering,
procurement, and installation under a single contract so there's no vendor juggling, no gaps in
responsibility. Ideal for factories, manufacturing plants, and industrial units in Haryana that need
a registered commercial solar installer to deliver a complete, commissioned system with full
ownership transferred to them.

### [ Solar OPEX Model ][36]

No upfront investment. No system ownership. Just cheaper electricity. Under the solar lease model,
the system is installed at your facility and you pay only for the units consumed at a rate lower
than your DISCOM tariff. The most practical option for warehouses, commercial buildings, and
factories in Haryana that need cheap solar energy without blocking capital.

### [ OPERATIONS & MAINTENANCE ][37]

A solar plant underperforms silently unless someone is actively monitoring it. O&M for commercial
and industrial solar installations covers preventive maintenance, real-time generation monitoring,
inverter health checks, and on-site fault response — all under SLA-backed timelines with an in-house
team, not outsourced vendors.

equipment benchmarking, and navigation of government solar schemes including industrial solar
subsidies in Haryana and rooftop solar applications in Rajasthan. A good solar consultant tells you
whether a project makes financial sense before anyone tries to sell you one.

ESG reporting, and sustainability documentation. Environmental advisory handles all of it, so your
solar project stays compliant with state and central regulations from approval to commissioning.
Especially relevant for industrial units in Haryana operating under environmental mandates or
targeting green certification for their facility.

## CAPEX Model

Pay for the Solar Power System in advance to fully own and control your solar power plant with Sun
Photonics.

### Pay at Start: Full cost paid upfront.

### Ownership: Customer owns the system.

### Maintenance: Customer is responsible.

### Savings: Keep all electricity savings.

## OPEX Model

No initial cost: pay for the electricity used, with the system managed by Sun Photonics. 

### No Upfront Cost: System owned by Sun Photonics.

### Payment: Pay per unit of energy.

### Maintenance: Handled by Sun Photonics.

### Low Initial Investment: Minimal initial cost.

## CAPEX Model

Pay for the Solar Power System in advance to fully own and control your solar power plant with Sun
Photonics.

### Pay at Start: Full cost paid upfront.

### Ownership: Customer owns the system.

### Maintenance: Customer is responsible.

### Savings: Keep all electricity savings.

## OPEX Model

No initial cost: pay for the electricity used, with the system managed by Sun Photonics. 

### No Upfront Cost: System owned by Sun Photonics.

### Payment: Pay per unit of energy.

### Maintenance: Handled by Sun Photonics.

### Low Initial Investment: Minimal initial cost.

### Sunpower India - Engineering, Procurement and Construction Services (EPC)

Sunpower India is a company of contracting arrangements & Technical Consultants performing projects
in Power Generation, Distribution, Transmission & Renewable Energy, where we act as an EPC
contractor or Consultants for all the activities from Site Selection and Procurement, Viability
Studies, Technical/Commercial Feasibility Analysis, Design, AC/DC works, Construction and
Commissioning of Power Evacuation Network up to 400 kV on Turnkey Basis.
Our engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) team provides bankable, innovative, and
reliable solutions to esteemed clients around the globe. We are able to provide a complete spectrum
of services for EPC projects from viability studies to commissioning.

### Sunpower India's Simple EPC
* Minimum Owner Effort
* One Point of Contact
* Simple, Uncomplicated Project Management & Monitoring
* Straight-Forward, Procurement, Installation, Commissioning & OMS Services
* HSE & Quality Assurance
* Owner Not Affected by Market Rise
* Effective use of Technology for Planning, Reporting & Monitoring

## About us

Transrail is a leading turnkey engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) company with primary
focus on power transmission and distribution business with 4 decades of experience in Construction
and Manufacturing. With its headquarters in India, it is a global enterprise with a footprint in
more than 60 Countries and 6 Continents.

## Our Business Portfolio

Transmission Lines Substations Solar EPC Railways Civil Poles & Lighting

### Transmission Lines

Our Transmission Lines expertise includes design, engineering, manufacturing (of towers, monopoles
and conductors), procurement, construction and commisioning of Transmission lines up to 1200kV on a
turn key basis. We have a footprint in more than 60 countries.

[ Know More ][199]

### Substations

We have executed various AIS and GIS substations on turnkey EPC basis in India and overseas. Our
capabilites include construction of susbstations upto **765 kV** through our expert internal teams.

[ Know More ][200]

### Solar EPC

As a specialised globally operating EPC Company we also provide holistic solutions for Solar EPC
including Solar farms, BESS, Pooling substations and grid connectivity.

[ Know More ][201]

### Railways

In the railways business, we provide comprehensive solutions including overhead electrification, S&T
systems, earthworks, track laying and other composite works.

[ Know More ][202]

### Civil

We undertake complex civil infrastructure projects on a turnkey EPC basis, including bridges,
tunnels, elevated roads and cooling towers with the help of our specilist teams.

[ Know More ][203]

### Poles & Lighting

We have a vast product range for Pole & Lighting infrastructure including highmasts, Streetlights,
Stadium lights, traffic lights, T&D monopoles, Railway portals etc. We are a manufacturers as well
as SITC (supply, installation, testing and commissioning) service provider.
[ Know More ][204]

## Our Strength

EPC Design and Engineering Manufacturing Tower Testing

### EPC

We provide turnkey EPC services across all our business verticals which includes Power Transmission,
Renewables, Civil Construction, Railways and Poles & Lighting. It includes design, engineering,
manufacturing (of towers, monopoles and conductors), procurement, construction and commisioning of
various large scale projects.
[ Know More ][205]

### Design and Engineering

We take pride in an Engineering focused organization with over 18,000 man month of experience in
design and engineering. We have team of more than 120 engineers in our D&E department whose
expertise helps us deliver quality and efficiency in our projects. We also have engineer who are
subject matter experts in each of our verticals.

[ Know More ][206]

### Manufacturing

We have integrated manufacturing facilities for lattice towers, conductors, and monopoles. Our
factories not just cater to our EPC projects but also helps us serve as an engineered product
supplier globally.

As part of our growth strategy, our factories are on expansion mode. We are enhancing capacity,
upgrading technology to meet increasing demand while maintaining stringent quality standards.

[ Know More ][207]

### Tower Testing

We have a state-of-art NABL accrediated tower testing facility at Deoli, where we test towers and
monopoles of all configurations.

[ Know More ][208]

focus on power transmission and distribution business with 4 decades of experience in Construction
and Manufacturing. With its headquarters in India, it is a global enterprise with a footprint in

## Our Business Portfolio

Transmission Lines Substations Solar EPC Railways Civil Poles & Lighting

### Transmission Lines

Our Transmission Lines expertise includes design, engineering, manufacturing (of towers, monopoles
and conductors), procurement, construction and commisioning of Transmission lines up to 1200kV on a
turn key basis. We have a footprint in more than 60 countries.

[ Know More ][199]

### Substations

We have executed various AIS and GIS substations on turnkey EPC basis in India and overseas. Our
capabilites include construction of susbstations upto **765 kV** through our expert internal teams.

[ Know More ][200]

### Solar EPC

As a specialised globally operating EPC Company we also provide holistic solutions for Solar EPC
including Solar farms, BESS, Pooling substations and grid connectivity.

[ Know More ][201]

### Railways

In the railways business, we provide comprehensive solutions including overhead electrification, S&T
systems, earthworks, track laying and other composite works.

[ Know More ][202]

### Civil

We undertake complex civil infrastructure projects on a turnkey EPC basis, including bridges,
tunnels, elevated roads and cooling towers with the help of our specilist teams.

[ Know More ][203]

### Poles & Lighting

We have a vast product range for Pole & Lighting infrastructure including highmasts, Streetlights,
Stadium lights, traffic lights, T&D monopoles, Railway portals etc. We are a manufacturers as well
as SITC (supply, installation, testing and commissioning) service provider.
[ Know More ][204]

## Our Strength

EPC Design and Engineering Manufacturing Tower Testing

### EPC

We provide turnkey EPC services across all our business verticals which includes Power Transmission,
Renewables, Civil Construction, Railways and Poles & Lighting. It includes design, engineering,
manufacturing (of towers, monopoles and conductors), procurement, construction and commisioning of
various large scale projects.
[ Know More ][205]

### Design and Engineering

We take pride in an Engineering focused organization with over 18,000 man month of experience in
design and engineering. We have team of more than 120 engineers in our D&E department whose
expertise helps us deliver quality and efficiency in our projects. We also have engineer who are
subject matter experts in each of our verticals.

[ Know More ][206]

### Manufacturing

We have integrated manufacturing facilities for lattice towers, conductors, and monopoles. Our
factories not just cater to our EPC projects but also helps us serve as an engineered product
supplier globally.

As part of our growth strategy, our factories are on expansion mode. We are enhancing capacity,
upgrading technology to meet increasing demand while maintaining stringent quality standards.

[ Know More ][207]

### Tower Testing

We have a state-of-art NABL accrediated tower testing facility at Deoli, where we test towers and
monopoles of all configurations.

[ Know More ][208]

## About TrustedChinaFactory

### Connecting Global Partners with Trusted Chinese Manufacturers

We started TrustedChinaFactory with one mission:

To help global buyers, distributors, and brands connect with authentic Chinese factories that
balance quality, compliance, and cost-effectiveness — making cross-border cooperation more
efficient, secure, and worry-free.

Whether you're looking for a professional manufacturing partner, verifying factory qualifications,
understanding mandatory product certification processes, or seeking cost-optimized production
solutions, we're here to guide you every step of the way.

We believe that the right Chinese factory can transform your supply chain, and we're passionate
about helping you build reliable cooperation relationships that enhance your business development.

### What Makes TrustedChinaFactory Different?

There are countless platforms connecting buyers with Chinese factories out there — but let's be
honest:

Most of them focus solely on matching transactions or providing superficial factory information that
doesn't really help you confirm if a manufacturer meets your quality, compliance, and production
needs.

We specialize in "trusted cooperation."

Everything we audit, verify, and recommend is designed to help you:
* Find Chinese factories that perfectly fit your product needs, quality standards, and budget
* Make sense of Chinese factory qualifications, production capabilities, and mandatory certification
  requirements
* Balance quality, compliance, production capacity, and cost-effectiveness
* Discover reliable solutions for cross-border cooperation challenges with Chinese manufacturers

We don't just match buyers with factories — we help you build a secure, long-term supply chain that
works for your business.

### Expert Audits, Trusted Verification

Our team of industry experts spends countless hours auditing and verifying Chinese factories:
* Comprehensive on-site factory audits to check production capacity, quality control systems, and
  compliance with mandatory product certification standards
* In-depth analysis of factory qualifications, production processes, and product consistency
* Comparison of similar factories to highlight key differences in capabilities, certifications, and
  cost
* Long-term follow-up observations to assess factory stability and reliability
* Practical advice on cooperation agreements, quality control, and certification application
  processes

We focus on what matters to real global partners — not just what's popular or low-cost.

### Our Content Philosophy

We aim to create content that is:
* Unbiased and honest in evaluating Chinese factories and their capabilities
* Detailed yet easy to understand for all levels of cross-border cooperation experience
* Practical and focused on solving real challenges in cooperating with Chinese manufacturers
* Up-to-date with the latest Chinese manufacturing policies, mandatory certification standards, and
  industry trends
* Tailored to different product categories, cooperation models, and budget ranges

Everything is written by industry experts with years of experience in Chinese manufacturing and
cross-border cooperation, ensuring you get the most accurate and helpful information possible.

### Cooperation Disclosure

Some links on this site are cooperation links — that means we may earn a small service fee if you
cooperate with factories through them (at no extra cost to you). We only recommend factories we have
personally audited, verified, and trust. No unqualified factories. No false propaganda.

We're excited to be part of your journey to build a secure, efficient, and high-quality supply chain

#### Quality and safety system in production

###### QA/QC (quality assurance/quality control)

Our QA/QC system is the foundation of every successful project. We employ international quality
standards and rigorous verification processes to ensure that every stage—from design and procurement
to installation and commissioning—meets the highest performance and compliance requirements.

Through continuous monitoring, testing, and corrective actions, we prevent defects before they occur
and ensure consistent results.

Our dedicated QA/QC team works closely with engineering, procurement, and construction departments
to ensure reliability, traceability, and high quality of every deliverable.

###### HSSE (health, safety, social and environment)

At UET Construction, excellence in HSSE and E&S is embedded in our 2026-2027 strategy and integrated
into every level of our operations. Guided by strong leadership and global best practices, we are
committed to protecting the people, environment, and communities in which we operate.

Our HSSE and E&S management system provides a structured framework for continuous improvement, risk
management, and full regulatory compliance. Through rigorous standards, comprehensive risk
assessments, ongoing training, and robust emergency preparedness, we ensure a safe and controlled
work environment on all projects.

We cultivate a culture of responsibility, discipline, and respect for life, striving for zero harm,
zero incidents, and sustainable performance in everything we do.

###### Environmental protection

We are committed to sustainable development and responsible business practices.

Our environmental and social responsibility (E&S) strategy aims to minimize environmental impacts,
conserve resources, and support local communities.

We implement best practices in waste management, emissions control, and environmental protection,
and promote social responsibility through stakeholder engagement and community support programs.

By maintaining a balance between growth, environmental stewardship, and social well-being, we create
long-term value for all stakeholders.

##### Anti-corruption policy and compliance

###### Preventing violations and protecting the company's interests

The Anti-Corruption Policy aims to prevent abuse, fraud, conflicts of interest, and other actions
that could harm the Company and its partners. The Policy is mandatory for all employees, managers,
contractors, and persons acting on behalf of the Company.

###### Zero tolerance policy for corruption

Our Company adheres to the principles of zero tolerance for corruption and unfair practices. To
ensure transparency and responsible business practices, we have implemented a corporate compliance
system based on Uzbek law and international standards.

###### Honesty, openness and accountability

We adhere to the principles of honesty, openness, and accountability. Every employee is obligated to
adhere to business ethics standards and prevent situations that create risks of violations. The
company provides trusted channels for reporting potential violations. All reports are handled
confidentially and objectively.

###### Responsibility and compliance culture

Compliance with anti-corruption laws and corporate policies is an integral part of our corporate
culture. We believe that honesty, openness, and responsibility are the foundation of sustainable
growth and reliable partnerships.

#### [UET Construction has begun construction of a solar power plant in Angren.][75]

[my_adm1n][76]2026-05-22T13:38:21+03:00
UET Construction has officially launched construction of a new solar power plant in Angren, a
project aimed at developing renewable energy and increasing the region's energy resilience. The
project is part of a national program to expand the use of clean energy sources and modernize
Uzbekistan's energy infrastructure. The solar power plant will be equipped with modern,
high-efficiency panels and monitoring technologies, ensuring stable generation and high performance.
UET Construction specialists are performing a comprehensive range of work on the project, including
site preparation, civil engineering, installation of mechanical and electrical equipment, and
commissioning. Company representatives note that the project is of strategic importance: it will
increase the share of alternative energy, reduce the burden on existing generation sources, and
contribute to a reduction in CO₂ emissions. Particular attention is being paid to compliance with
international quality, safety, and environmental standards. According to the implementation plan,
construction of the plant will be completed on schedule. Once commissioned, the power plant will
provide the region with additional capacity and contribute to the sustainable development and energy
independence of Angren and the surrounding areas.

## About UTL Solar

### Who We Are?

UTL Solar operates under Fujiyama Power Systems Limited. It is a well-established name in the solar
energy and power backup industry. The company manufactures a wide range of solar products including
solar panels, inverters, batteries, and complete solar power systems for homes and businesses. Its
product portfolio also includes Online UPS, Offline UPS, Battery Chargers, Solar Management Units
(SMU), Solar Charge Controllers, and On-Grid Systems, enabling it to meet diverse customer
requirements with reliability and quality. With a strong focus on innovation and advanced
technology, UTL Solar’s high-performance products, large-scale production capacity, and expanding
dealer network have strengthened its ability to deliver efficient solar solutions and dependable
customer support across India.

## Frequently Asked Questions

How is computing investment different from crypto mining?

Computing investment is about renting computing power for real-world use cases like AI training and
scientific computing. Revenue comes from enterprise clients' leasing fees. This is fundamentally
different from crypto mining — our revenue model is based on real commercial demand and long-term
contracts, not token price fluctuations.

What is the minimum investment threshold?

We offer tiered plans starting from ¥99,000 for the Starter. The Pro plan suits high-net-worth
clients, while the Enterprise plan is customized to your specific needs. All plans provide
transparent return expectations and risk disclosures.

How is my computing asset secured?

All computing equipment is deployed in our T3+ certified data center with 24/7 security, fire
suppression, and climate control systems. We also provide asset insurance, real-time monitoring
dashboards, and regular audit reports. Contracts clearly define asset ownership to ensure your
rights are legally protected.

How are returns calculated and distributed?

Returns are calculated based on the actual rental of your hosted computing resources, accumulated
daily and settled monthly. You can monitor utilization rates, revenue details, and settlement
progress in real-time through your dedicated dashboard. We offer bank transfers, USDT, and other
settlement methods.

Can I visit the data center in person?

Absolutely. We organize regular customer tours where you can see the scale and operational standards
of our super factory firsthand. Professional plan and above customers enjoy complimentary quarterly
visits. Starter plan customers can schedule paid visits. Please contact your account manager in
advance to arrange your trip.

## Frequently Asked Questions

How is computing investment different from crypto mining?

Computing investment is about renting computing power for real-world use cases like AI training and
scientific computing. Revenue comes from enterprise clients' leasing fees. This is fundamentally
different from crypto mining — our revenue model is based on real commercial demand and long-term
contracts, not token price fluctuations.

What is the minimum investment threshold?

We offer tiered plans starting from ¥99,000 for the Starter. The Pro plan suits high-net-worth
clients, while the Enterprise plan is customized to your specific needs. All plans provide
transparent return expectations and risk disclosures.

How is my computing asset secured?

All computing equipment is deployed in our T3+ certified data center with 24/7 security, fire
suppression, and climate control systems. We also provide asset insurance, real-time monitoring
dashboards, and regular audit reports. Contracts clearly define asset ownership to ensure your
rights are legally protected.

How are returns calculated and distributed?

Returns are calculated based on the actual rental of your hosted computing resources, accumulated
daily and settled monthly. You can monitor utilization rates, revenue details, and settlement
progress in real-time through your dedicated dashboard. We offer bank transfers, USDT, and other
settlement methods.

Can I visit the data center in person?

Absolutely. We organize regular customer tours where you can see the scale and operational standards
of our super factory firsthand. Professional plan and above customers enjoy complimentary quarterly
visits. Starter plan customers can schedule paid visits. Please contact your account manager in
advance to arrange your trip.
